main_text.p: stiofuli alicuius, maleque-feriati homuncionis Ϛατανᾶς; Lubenter quidem fouere vellet opinionem hanc charitas nostra, credula illa certè, & quæ (Apostoli iussu) ἐ λογίζεται τὸ κακόν: ni etiam in Ecclefijs quibusdam publicè decantari moneat Cassander,istud(bone Deus) quale carmen,
Ni hæc omnia a pijssimis Ecclefiæ Romanæ censoribus, rigidis morum magistris, ipsorumque Pontificum suffragijs palàm comprobata essent, ni-1.Cor.13.
ἐ λογίζεται τὸ κακόν: 1. Cor. 13. (Greek phrase, as printed.)

page.notes: Greek words in the first paragraph are printed in Greek letters; the transcription of the Greek is approximate. Right margin note "1.Cor.13." placed beside the paragraph. Some letters in the lower left are faint; catchword fragment "fi" at the foot right is uncertain.
